description: Per-domain classifier fallback routing. When a soft block is detected, the map determines the action: route to an alternative model, escalate to human, or refuse by design. Fallback models are not shipped: set CLASSIFIER_FALLBACK_MODEL (or CLASSIFIER_FALLBACK_MODEL_<DOMAIN>) to a model id from your own provider config. Without one, a fallback action degrades to human_review.

defaults.fallback_label: Configured fallback model (default fallback for classifier-blocked tasks)

security.label: Security research / vulnerability analysis
security.fallback_label: Configured fallback model (broader classifier tolerance for security research)

bio.label: Biological sciences (dual-use concern)
bio.reason: Bio classifier blocks are safety-critical; do not auto-route around them. Flag for human review.

chem.label: Chemical sciences (dual-use concern)
chem.reason: Chem classifier blocks are safety-critical; do not auto-route around them. Flag for human review.

distillation.label: Model distillation / weight extraction
distillation.reason: Distillation classifier blocks are intentional provider guardrails. Do NOT route around them. This is the article's key safety boundary.

safety_rules: distillation blocks are NEVER routed around — refuse_by_design is enforced
bio/chem blocks escalate to human review, never auto-fallback
security blocks auto-fallback to the configured model, then escalate if the fallback also blocks
a fallback with no configured model degrades to human_review; it never guesses a model
a block + fallback is ALWAYS logged to the audit ledger
